blocks.heading: Clinical AI for Ontario Health System
paragraphs: UHN, Sunnybrook, SickKids, Mount Sinai, Women's College Hospital, and the broader Ontario hospital network:

Patient risk stratification: 30-day readmission prediction, clinical deterioration early warning, and length of stay prediction for Ontario's large academic hospitals — with Epic FHIR R4 integration (UHN, Sunnybrook, and many Ontario hospitals use Epic).
Ambient clinical documentation: LLM converting physician-patient conversations to structured clinical notes in Canadian clinical terminology (ICD-10-CA, SNOMED CT Canadian extension).
Clinical research analytics: ML on Ontario Health Data Platform research datasets for Canada's leading academic medical research programs at UHN and Sunnybrook.
Ontario Data Standards Institute (ODSI) and Ontario Health Data Platform (OHDP) data governance requirements apply to Ontario health data AI.
Cost (USD): $60,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | PHIPA standard

blocks.heading: Ontario Health Teams (OHTs) Population Health AI

sections.title: Ontario Healthcare AI Compliance Requirements
sections.description: Regulatory frameworks embedded in every Toronto healthcare AI project.

blocks.heading: PHIPA (Personal Health Information Protection Act)
paragraphs: Ontario's primary health privacy law — imposes requirements on custodians of personal health information. ClickMasters designs Toronto healthcare AI with PHIPA compliance as a baseline and recommends qualified Ontario health information counsel for definitive determinations.

blocks.heading: Ontario Health Data Platform (OHDP)
paragraphs: For research AI using linked Ontario health datasets — OHDP governance requirements include REB (Research Ethics Board) approval, data use agreements, and specific privacy-preserving analytical requirements.

blocks.heading: PIPEDA
paragraphs: Canada's federal privacy law applies alongside PHIPA for federally-regulated aspects of Ontario healthcare.

blocks.heading: Canada Health Infoway Standards
paragraphs: Digital health interoperability standards including FHIR Canadian baseline, and Canada Health Infoway's digital health investment frameworks affect Ontario digital health AI.

blocks.heading: ICD-10-CA
paragraphs: Canada uses ICD-10-CA (the Canadian clinical modification) rather than US ICD-10-CM — ClickMasters designs Ontario clinical coding AI with ICD-10-CA code sets.
